summary: PR-1878 adds one HTTPS outbound integration (payment-advice) and its asset-inventory entry. The new integration meets ENC-2 and INV-1, both shown by exhaustive control tests that passed in the head-commit CI run with nothing skipped. The process records are complete: an approved standard ticket covering both components, independent code review, security review and control-owner approval, all on the single head commit. No exceptions are needed and no ledgered evidence lapses. Git and CI re-runs were blocked in this session, so the touched-file set comes from working-tree timestamps cross-checked against the ticket and commit records, not from a direct diff.
